Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:
> Shouldn't Catacombs read "When encountering a vampire in torpor,"?

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_C.html#Catacombs
Catacombs [AH]
Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 1 blood
This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as
equipment while in play. When attempting to rescue a vampire from torpor,
the vampire with this location gets +1 stealth and burns one less blood if
successful.

> Or does it mean that, after successfully encountering a vampire in
> torpor, if you choose to rescue, then... ?

Last I checked the rules, you don't "encounter a vampire it torpor" and
then choose later. You *either* declare diablerie *or* declare a rescue,
(and when you do, you must annouce how the blood will be paid.)
So, no, you can't use the Catacombs as a way to get +1 stealth on
diablerie. =P Play the Hunt Club, instead. =)

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta
